faqs.q: Can I switch plans at any time?
faqs.a: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. When upgrading, you'll be charged the prorated difference. When downgrading, the new rate takes effect at your next billing cycle.
Each connected social account counts as one channel. For example, one Facebook Page, one Instagram account, and one TikTok account would be 3 channels. Paid plans allow up to 8 channels per brand.
Starter: 10 GB storage. Growth: 50 GB storage. Pro: 100 GB storage. Business: Unlimited storage.

faqs.q: What happens when I reach my storage limit?
faqs.a: You can keep publishing posts that use media already in your workspace. Only new uploads are blocked. Free up space by deleting media you no longer need, or upgrade your plan at any time for more storage.

faqs.q: How does the free trial work?
faqs.a: Every plan, monthly and annual, includes a {trialDays}-day free trial. Your card is collected at signup but won't be charged until the trial ends. Cancel anytime during the trial and pay nothing.

faqs.q: Which plans include the free trial?
faqs.a: No charge for {trialDays} days · Cancel anytime. Save up to 17%.

faqs.q: Can my AI agent or my own software use Markaestro?
faqs.a: Yes, on every paid plan at no extra cost. Any workspace admin can mint API keys from Settings → API and hand one to an AI agent, a script, or an off-the-shelf scheduling tool. Each key is bound to a single brand, carries only the scopes you tick, and can be given an expiry. MCP clients such as Claude Code can sign in through the browser instead. See the AI agent guide for the tool definitions and a working four-command quickstart.

faqs.q: Do you offer discounts for nonprofits or startups?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer 50% off for verified nonprofits and early-stage startups (under $1M revenue). Contact us to apply.

faqs.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex). Enterprise plans can pay by invoice.
